description: This file defines the RefreshToken entity class used in an authentication context within a learning management system backend, representing a refresh token stored in the database.

classes.name: RefreshToken
classes.description: Represents a refresh token entity with fields for token details, related to user authentication.

methods.name: RefreshToken(Long userId, String tokenHash, Instant expiresAt)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to create a new refresh token instance.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the refresh token.

methods.name: getUserId()
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getTokenHash()
methods.description: Returns the hash of the token.

methods.name: getExpiresAt()
methods.description: Returns the expiry timestamp of the token.

methods.name: isRevoked()
methods.description: Checks if the token has been revoked.
